summary: Tested the EquiMind 'About you' context feature (backend and UI) and the new Biglyp Wellbeing logo / 'Back' strip. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass. EquiMind start returns 3 context_questions (living, contact, lonely). MindMellow, MindEdge and FocusEdge return []. Submitting hostel/rarely/often gives context {away, low_contact, feels_lonely, detachment: true} with labels, and it is saved (GET /reports/{id}). Submit without context gives context null. All-invalid values give null. Partly-invalid values: the invalid key is dropped and the valid keys are kept. Counsellor flag 'Away from family — possible loneliness / detachment (...)' appears when the latest report has detachment. Admin bank has the renamed D4 sub-theme and the new D1/D4 items. UI: stu-meera check-in shows the About you step: 5/6/6 options, Continue disabled until all 3 are answered, progress bar hidden, key '3' ignored on this step. The 24 statements then work (keys and clicks). The report shows family-distance-card for hostel. stu-rohan with 'At home with my parents' shows no card. FocusEdge (fe-aarav) and MindEdge (me-riya) go straight to question 1. Logo strip: present on product, login, dashboard and counsellor pages and absent on '/'. Logo links to '/', with img /biglyp-logo.png and sub-text 'Wellbeing'. Back works in-app (counsellor student → /counsellor) and falls back to '/' when the page is opened directly. Hub header logo and product tab switching work. No horizontal overflow at 1920 or 390px. No page errors.

issues: Copy pastes the first-person option label in lowercase: 'You told us you're in a hostel or pg, away from my parents and talk to family rarely — less than once a week'. 'PG' becomes 'pg' and it says 'my parents' in a second-person sentence. Use second-person phrasings per option, e.g. 'living in a hostel or PG, away from your parents'.
Flag text also uses the student-facing first-person label: '(In a hostel or PG, away from my parents, ...)'. Consider a counsellor-facing label such as 'Hostel/PG'.
The selected option chip is only slightly darker than unselected chips (pale blue on pale blue), so it is hard to see what is selected. Use a solid bg-eq/white text like the scale options.

action_items: Optional copy fix: second-person wording in the family-distance-card (no lowercasing of 'PG', no 'my parents')
Optional: stronger selected state on about-* chips
Optional: update the stale PageNav.jsx doc comment, which still says 'Previous page' + 'Back to home page'
critical_code_review_comments: server.py submit: invalid context keys/values are filtered correctly. If every value is invalid, context_summary gets {} and returns None (good).
SubmitIn.context is Dict[str,str]: a non-string value (e.g. a number) gives a 422 for the whole submit instead of being ignored. Low risk because the UI only sends strings.
seed_data_creation: Created EquiMind reports: stu-rohan has 4 via API (invalid ctx, partial ctx, no ctx, hostel/rarely/often) plus 1 via UI (family/daily/rarely, now the latest, so no counsellor flag). stu-meera has 1 via UI (hostel/rarely/often, so counsellor flag shown). /assessments/start for mm-diya, me-riya and fe-aarav left in_progress assessments; this is normal, and start returns the existing one.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0 (not -p no:xdist), because the iter30 tests depend on order: the last submit must carry the full context so the counsellor flag check passes. stu-rohan and stu-meera now have reports, so their next check-ins are retakes. Check-in testids: begin-checkin-btn, about-you-step, about-{key}-{value}, about-you-continue, option-scale-N, submit-checkin-btn. The FocusEdge dashboard auto-opens a daily check-in dialog that blocks clicks; press Escape first.
